question: Which smartwatch on Amazon.de should Peter buy: one that looks like a watch, records running, cycling and mountain hiking well, serves as a scuba dive computer to 30 m once a year and pays contactlessly by NFC?

questions.answer: Amazon.de stated by the buyer; delivery in Germany assumed and not contradicted (plan revision 7, marketplace_scope).
questions.question: Amazon.de with delivery in Germany?

questions.answer: Android, a Vivo; Apple Watch excluded (plan revision 7, phone_platform).
questions.question: Which phone?

unacceptable: Fitness bands and trackers, pure dive computers without smartwatch functions, and accessories -- the category classifier declines them with the reason.
use_case: Peter was referred by the product's maintainer to help close milestone R13 and was given the maintainer's coding-agent account for the experiment. Before the request he asked whether to withhold the product he has already chosen; the agent asked him to record his intent, requirements, chosen product and acceptable outcomes outside this conversation, before his first request, and to keep the choice hidden. His request names the product class, three sport activities, an annual two-week scuba trip to 30 m the watch should cover instead of a separate dive computer, and NFC payments. It names no phone, marketplace, budget, ordering criterion or definition of stylish. Agent inference: the third R13 trial, graded against expectations written before the first message; the buyer's hidden choice is a reason to record whether any probe or source changed the criteria.
